text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas Eve.
Following Fine Motion's suggestion, we were to hold a quiet party, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Pardon the interruption during your conversation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tazuna-san!
Merry Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's something I'd like
Fine Motion-san to take a look at...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

What Tazuna brought over was
a cardboard box packed full of—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Petition Concerning the Continuation of Fine Motion's Racing Career"...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are all of these signatures...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What we brought here is only part of it.
There are still dozens of boxes in the office.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why...?
choice_data_list: Because I want to keep watching you run.
Because I want to keep watching you run.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, as the academy, our primary priority
is to respect Fine Motion's circumstances
and her own wishes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Even so, I had to let you know that there are opinions like this out there."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, I've got to sort out these cardboard boxes.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Please wait.
...May I take a look at what is inside?

After Ms. Tazuna left,
at Fine Motion's request,
we decided to take a short walk outside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...That really is nice.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To have tens of thousands of people
wishing for you to run...
is truly, truly an honor.
choice_data_list: That proves you made an impact.
That proves you made an impact.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're surprisingly reckless yourself.
After all, there's no way to prove an 'impact' even happened.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see.
Looks like you've gone and proved it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm in everyone's hearts,
then I won't feel lonely~."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's true!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Saying that might be
putting on a bit of a brave face, though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: However, that is more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's warm feelings are the greatest
Christmas present I could ever ask for.

Fine Motion, smiling warmly,
looked genuinely happy from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
It's chilly, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You should just draw it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, well, it can't be helped
even if we can't go anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding.
I was in the middle of cooking, so let's head back!

And so, the Christmas night
quietly deepened.

Fine Motion, smiling warmly,
looked genuinely happy from the bottom of her heart.
choice_data_list: Then you don't need any more presents?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here! I'm here!
Ooh, did you get something for me?"

When I thought about what Christmas present
would make Fine Motion happy...
one thing immediately came to mind.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Step right... Wait, no.
Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas to you all~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer.
What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what took you so long, apprentice!
Come on, get in the kitchen, get in!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What?!
What does that mean~?!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well, right before Christmas, this gentleman here
suddenly came by wanting to make his own
original ramen at our place.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I turned him down at first... but when he said it was for one of our regulars, I decided to lend a hand.

"Yes. For Fine Motion's sake... finding whatever
spare time she had, day after day,
she devoted herself to training."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~~?! 
No one told me about this?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Since it is a present,
it is only natural to keep it a secret.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait, did everyone else go through training too...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool.
I merely came because that Trainer invited me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When I hear the entire restaurant is reserved and it's all on your dime,
how could I possibly sit still?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This is to hype us up before the big match!
(Swish... Swish, swish!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Trainer,
that's a magnificent cross slash...!

And so,
after exhaustive research upon research, the ramen was finally complete!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Amazing, the broth is so glossy...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the naruto is shaped like
a four-leaf clover...! It's so cute...♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer...!
This is the best present ever~!
choice_data_list: Eat up before it gets cold!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mm...!
Let's eat, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!
